caseNameFull: Philadelphia Inquirer Co. v. Coe, Commissioner of Patents
attorneys: Mr. Frank E. Scrivener for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Shea, and Messrs. Valentine Brookes and Leon Frechtel for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia denied.

Mr. Justice Rutledge took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
